name: CubingUSA Southern Championship 2023

venue.name: [Austin Convention Center](https://www.austinconventioncenter.com/)
venue.address: 500 E Cesar Chavez St, Austin, TX 78701

information:
This competition is supported by [CubingUSA](https://cubingusa.org/) as the Southern Regional Championship of 2023.
The following states are eligible for the title of Southern Champion: Texas, Oklahoma, Arkansas, Louisiana, and Mississippi.

Please note that the [schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SouthernChampionship2023#competition-schedule) is subject to change, as we may hold events slightly earlier or later than shown depending on whether the competition is running ahead of schedule or behind schedule.

Please go through the other tabs on the website for more information, especially the [Important Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SouthernChampionship2023#25382-important-information) tab. If you have any other questions, feel free to check out the [FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SouthernChampionship2023#28206-faq) tab or contact us!

## *No outside food or drink will be allowed in the venue.*
